name: Contraloría General
body: nosniff, framing limited to its origin, GA4, and a home description. But robots.txt points crawlers to http://www.contraloria.gov.co:8080/sitemap.xml, which timed out, and plain http answers 404.
lesson: List the sitemap's public https URL in robots.txt, then open it in a browser to check it answers.
summary: www.contraloria.gov.co scores 66 out of 100 (D). 4 checks fail now, 26 are at risk, and 16 pass. Fix first: HSTS is not sent.

fix.title: HSTS is not sent
fix.evidence: strict-transport-security was absent on the start page. Missing on all 20 pages read. A first visit over http can be intercepted.

fix.title: Plain http serves the site without redirecting
fix.evidence: http:// answered 404. Visitors who type the address stay unencrypted.
fix.fix: Redirect every http request to https with a 301, then add HSTS.

fix.title: 3 form controls have no label
fix.evidence: On /es/web/guest/contraloria/talento-humano/resoluciones-de-nombramiento, /es/web/guest/contraloria/talento-humano/comunicados, /contraloria/planeacion-gestion-y-control/gestion-documental. Screen readers announce them as an unnamed field.
fix.fix: Pair each control with <label for>, wrap it in a label, or add aria-label.

fix.title: 9 pages name another URL as canonical
fix.fix: Make each page's canonical point at itself unless it is a real duplicate.

fix.title: No content security policy
fix.evidence: content-security-policy was absent on the start page. Missing on all 20 pages read. Injected scripts are not limited by the browser.
fix.fix: Start with the Report-Only policy in the fix kit, watch the reports for a week, then enforce it.

fix.title: 18 pages have no meta description
fix.evidence: /web/guest/la-entidad, /es/web/guest/contraloria/la-entidad/organigrama-y-dependencias, /web/guest/simbolos-institucionales, /contraloria/la-entidad/historiaycontralores and 14 more. Google and AI answers then write their own snippet from whatever text they…
fix.fix: Write a 50 to 160 character description for each page that says what a reader gets.

works.title: Every internal link that was opened answered
AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page
Every image has an alt attribute
The start page arrived in 707 ms
A sitemap answers with valid URLs
